the role of methionine residues in beta 1-bungrarotoxin.
the structure-activity relationships of beta 1-neurotoxin, a phospholipases A2 neurotoxin, and its derivatives.
the elucidation of the mechanism of action of beta 1-toxin, a phospholipid-dependent neurotoxin from snake venom.
